## [Monthly Aerosol Optical Properties from MERRA-2 Reanalysis](https://doi.org/10.25326/383){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}

Global distribution of monthly aerosol optical properties (extinction, single scattering albedo and
asymmetry parameter) created from the NASA MERRA-2 3-hourly reanalysis profiles of aerosol mixing
ratio and relative humidity, and MERRA-2 species level aerosol optical properties for different
humidities and spectral bands.

The data are meant to be used in climate models or for other applications requiring aerosol optical properties.

[ACCESS DATA](https://doi.org/10.25326/383){target="_blank" rel="noopener" .access-button}
